title: CoachSI: Self-Improvement of Robot Policies with a Language Coach
abstract: arXiv:2611.25529v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generalist robot policies execute atomic skills reliably but fail when the same skills are composed into long-horizon tasks. Self-improvement from the policy's own experience does not close this gap: experience collected by the policy alone stays within its own distribution and reproduces what it can already do. We show that what the policy lacks is not a skill but the next step. We present CoachSI, a self-improvement method in which a frozen, off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM) coaches the policy in language: it watches the robot and names the next step in the format of the policy's atomic instructions, and never outputs an action. Successful coached rollouts are relabeled in hindsight with the original task instruction and used to fine-tune the policy. The fine-tuned policy is then deployed on its own. translated_title: CoachSI：利用语言教练实现机器人策略的自我改进
translated_abstract: 通用机器人策略能够可靠地执行原子技能，但当这些技能被组合成长时程任务时却会失败。仅依靠策略自身经验进行自我改进无法弥合这一差距：策略单独收集的经验停留在其自身分布之内，只会重现它已经能做到的事情。我们证明，策略所缺少的不是某项技能，而是下一步该做什么。我们提出 CoachSI，这是一种自我改进方法：一个冻结的、现成的视觉-语言模型（VLM）以语言方式指导策略——它观察机器人，并按照策略原子指令的格式说出下一步，而从不输出动作。成功的受指导执行轨迹会被事后重新标记为原始任务指令，并用于微调策略。微调后的策略随后即可独立部署。在世界动作模型与视觉-语言-动作模型均已停滞的状态下，仅“说出下一步”即可提升子目标完成度（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出 CoachSI：用冻结的现成视觉-语言模型仅以语言形式为机器人策略“说出下一步”原子指令，再将成功的受指导轨迹事后重标记为原任务指令来微调策略，从而突破策略自身经验分布限制、实现长时程任务的自我改进。
en_tdlr: CoachSI enables robot policy self-improvement on long-horizon tasks by having a frozen off-the-shelf VLM coach purely in language—naming the next atomic step—and fine-tuning the policy on hindsight-relabeled successful coached rollouts.
